description: Explainable synthetic tax-risk indicators for the TAX-024 pilot scenarios. A signal asks for human review or evidence; it is never a tax assessment, refund decision, fraud finding or legal conclusion.

gateway.name: TR-GATEWAY-ALL v1.0.0
gateway.description: Jube evaluates activation rules only after a gateway rule matches; every synthetic return is admitted.

features.name: documented_input_vat
features.derivation: Sum of vat_amount over purchase invoices

features.name: related_party_purchase_net
features.derivation: Sum of net_amount over purchase invoices whose contract is marked related_party

features.name: consecutive_loss_periods
features.derivation: Length of the run of consecutive loss quarters in loss_periods ending at the return period (0 when the return period is not a loss period)

features.name: imported_service_unverified_count
features.derivation: Count of purchase invoices with vat_status treatment_unverified

rules.title: VAT refund claim exceeds documented input VAT
rules.explanation: Claimed input VAT {claimed_input_vat} exceeds VAT shown on the supplied purchase invoices {documented_input_vat} by {unsupported_input_vat}. Request the missing supporting invoices; this is not a refund decision.
rules.cleared_explanation: Claimed input VAT {claimed_input_vat} equals VAT shown on the supplied purchase invoices {documented_input_vat}. Arithmetic support only; a human still clears the refund.

rules.title: Purchases from a disclosed related party
rules.explanation: Purchases of {related_party_purchase_net} (net) were made under a contract marked related-party. Pricing, benefit and intent are not established; ask for the service agreement and pricing basis.

rules.title: Losses in consecutive periods
rules.explanation: The synthetic return history shows {consecutive_loss_periods} consecutive loss periods ending in the return period. Losses can be legitimate; ask for the business explanation.

rules.title: Imported service with unverified tax treatment
rules.explanation: {imported_service_unverified_count} purchase invoice(s) for imported services carry no verified VAT or withholding treatment. Request the treatment evidence; no liability is established.
